read.thesis: Cognizant delivered 3.8% organic cc growth in Q4 and guided FY26 to 4-6.5% (3.8% organic at midpoint), with margin 15.9-16.1% and EPS $5.56-5.70; large deal TCV up 60% but ACV declined modestly.

triggers.label: Large deal TCV up 60% in Q4
triggers.quote: The value of these large deal wins is 60% greater than a year ago.
triggers.highlight: The value of these large deal wins is 60% greater

triggers.label: FY26 organic growth midpoint ~3.8%
triggers.quote: The midpoint of the range implies organic revenue growth of approximately 3.8%, which is consistent with our 2025 performance.

triggers.label: ACV declined modestly YoY
triggers.quote: Annual contract value declined modestly year over year due to the mix of longer-duration deals and softness in small deal banks.
triggers.highlight: Annual contract value declined modestly year over year

triggers.label: Gross margin down on bonus and salary
triggers.quote: Q4 impact on gross margin was predominantly on account of higher bonus funding that we did for the full year.
triggers.highlight: predominantly on account of higher bonus funding

guidance.quote: For the full year, we expect revenue to grow 4% to 6.5% in constant currency.
Our adjusted operating margin guidance is 15.9% to 16.1%, which represents 10 to 30 basis points of expansion
This leads to adjusted diluted EPS guidance of $5.56 to $5.70, representing 5% to 8% year-over-year growth.
We expect free cash flow conversion of 90-100% of net income.

guidance.metric: Q1 FY26 constant currency revenue growth
guidance.quote: For the first quarter, we expect revenue to grow 2.7% to 4.2% year over year in constant currency.
we expect to return approximately $1.6 billion of capital to shareholders

red_flags.label: ACV declined modestly YoY
red_flags.quote: Annual contract value declined modestly year over year due to the mix of longer-duration deals and softness in small deal banks.

red_flags.label: Fixed-price risk shifted to vendor
red_flags.quote: the larger component of delivery risk resides with the service providers like us.

evasions.quote: we have guided for the overall operating margin line. I want to guide at both the lines.
At this juncture, we are still thinking through the decision, the regulatory framework
